body:
# The Official Cobblemon Survival Guide Modpack

Want to play the exact modpack used in my **Cobblemon Survival Guide** YouTube series? You're in the right place!

This is the complete modpack I use throughout the series, including all of the quality-of-life mods, progression features, and gameplay improvements that make Cobblemon feel like a true Pokémon adventure.

# Included Features

## 🥊 Gym Leaders & Trainer Battles

Take on Gym Leaders and NPC trainers using the Radical Red integration.

You'll also encounter aggressive wild Pokémon thanks to **Fight or Flight**, creating a more action-packed survival experience where your Pokémon can help defend you from hostile mobs.

---

## ⭐ Legendary, Mythical, Mega & Paradox Pokémon

Catch nearly every Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beast, and Paradox Pokémon with the **All The Mons** datapack.

The modpack also includes **Cobblemon Mega Showdown**, bringing Mega Evolution into your survival world.

---

## 🧭 Better Exploration & Rare Pokémon Hunting

Finding rare Pokémon is much easier with several exploration tools:

* Xaero's Minimap
* PokéNav biome lookup
* Spawn Notifications for Legendary, Mythical, Shiny and Paradox Pokémon

Spend less time guessing where Pokémon spawn and more time catching them.

---

## ✨ Quality of Life Improvements

The pack also includes many community-favorite improvements including:

* Livelier Pokémon
* Pasture Loot Mod
* Capture XP
* and many more!

Everything is designed to make survival smoother without changing the core Cobblemon experience.

---
